command: find . -maxdepth 1 -type d -print0 | xargs -0 -I {} sh -c 'echo $(find {} | wc -l) \\t {}' | sort -rn | less
why: `sh` runs the script echo $(find {} | wc -l) \\t {}; its effects depend on that file.
`find … -exec` runs a command on every match; its effect is shown below.
